---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
shortened_seasons <- c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    home_runs_per_game = home_runs / team_games,
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% shortened_seasons,
      "Shortened season",
      "Full-length season"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "black") +
  geom_point(
    data = \(data) filter(data, season_type == "Shortened season"),
    aes(color = season_type),
    size = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Season",
    values = c("Shortened season" = "#D55E00"),
    breaks = "Shortened season"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Major League Baseball Home Runs per Team-Game",
    subtitle = "Shortened seasons are highlighted",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per team-game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
